text.p: Proffitt's Inc said Thursday it was "comfortable with (its) 1996 earnings guidance of $2.24 per share on a fully diluted basis before the merger with Herberger's and non-recurring items."

R. Brad Martin, Proffitt's chairman and chief executive officer, said in a release that total sales performance for the combined November-December period was solid, and the company remains comfortable with the 1996 earnings estimate.
The First Call analysts' consensus estimate for Proffitt's fiscal year ending January 1997 is $2.25 per share.
Proffitt's said its recently announced acquisition of G.R. Herberger's Inc, a 40-unit department store company headquartered in St. Cloud, Minn., is expected to close in early 1997.
For the combined November and December period, total company sales were $547.4 million this year, a 45 percent increase over last year, Proffitt's said.

Total sales of $547.4 million include $170.6 million of sales from the Parisian Division. On a comparable stores basis, excluding Parisian, total company sales were up three percent over last year for the two months, it said.
